Yoru can now send you a few words about your music, and notes get a proper place to write.

## New

- **Messages from Yoru** (Android). One to three short notifications a day about your own music: a song you haven't heard in a while, a line from lyrics you love, a guess about who's been on repeat, or a song for your morning. Tap one and it plays. If you stay away for a month, Yoru will check on you once. Messages are written on your phone from your own library and never sent anywhere. Change how often, or turn them off, in Settings > General. Turning Yoru off stops them too.

## Improved

- **Notes on songs have a new card.** It rises from the bottom, gives you a clean page to write on, and can be pulled down to close. Notes can now be up to 500 characters and keep their line breaks.

## Fixed

- **The page behind the player now stays put when you swipe the player down.** Detail pages like Artist no longer slide to the left and leave a dark gap, and Home no longer turns blank. You see the page you came from, blurred and coming back into focus.

Android will ask once whether ForYou may show notifications. If messages arrive late or not at all, see Settings > Help > Messages from Yoru.
